name: 08-zod-registry-stale-ids
title: Keep registry id map in sync when schemas are re-registered
body: Calling `registry.add()` again on a schema with a different `id` left the old id pointing at the schema. `add()` now drops the previous id mapping, and both `add()` and `remove()` only delete an id if it still maps to the schema being changed, so ids claimed by another schema are left alone.

bugs.why: The ownership check is inverted (`!==` instead of `===`), so add() keeps the stale id when it still maps to this schema and deletes another schema's id mapping when it doesn't.
